descriptions.f12b_clear_globals_801fd238: Clears original global control resources through native C++ ownership: deletes eight 40-byte controls in two groups of four and clears their pointer groups; releases and clears two registry groups, each with three indexed and two iterated interface slots; deletes two 32-byte single-interface string controls; releases and clears three final shared interface slots; returns zero. Inlined group and held-interface reset APIs preserve the original iteration, lifetime, and zero-argument scheduling. Complete allocated control storage is represented, while registry groups are partial observed global views. Names, types, and roles are inferred; referenced globals remain externally owned.
